title: Nixon–Ford era decision to privatize the legacy program

tellings.quote: legacy program lore, which has since filtered out, um, is that there was a decision made in the Nixon administration into the Ford administration to essentially privatize this

plain: Sometime in the Nixon years, carrying on into the Ford years, a decision was made to hand the "legacy program" over to private hands. That is the name insiders use for a secret effort said to hold recovered non-human craft. Matthew Brown, a former Pentagon official who has come forward as a whistleblower, relays this as "legacy program lore" that has since leaked out, not as something he saw. If true, it would explain why such a program could sit outside the government's normal oversight.
